event.text: I recommend a non-urgent clinician review in this Counsel thread, with a same-day service-hours target, to discuss your symptom pattern and the hormone and non-hormone options and their risks and benefits. Meanwhile, layered clothing, a cool bedroom and limiting alcohol, caffeine and spicy foods may help. If you develop very heavy bleeding, bleeding after 12 period-free months, or severe pelvic pain, arrange prompt in-person assessment.
